messages:
maria: Heads-up — during a quick smoke I hit a redirect chain on the runbook page /runbooks/oncall/redirects that ends in a 404. Noticed while testing canary deploy. Anyone own that runbook?
kevin: Ugh, thanks for the ping. Can you paste the curl output?
maria: sure, pasted output below:
```
$ curl -I https://kb.redwood.ai/runbooks/oncall/redirects
HTTP/1.1 302 Found
Location: https://short.redwood.ai/old-redirects
HTTP/1.1 301 Moved Permanently
Location: https://kb.redwood.ai/runbooks/oncall/redirects-v2
HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found
```
sam: @kevin I can take this. Looks like the shortlink service is still routing to the old path. Also the screenshot on that page is cropped weird — we should replace it with the new 2x PNG. :camera:
kevin: awesome, thanks Sam. If you pick it up, add a PR with title `docs: fix redirect chain + screenshot` and ping me for review. small nit: prefer absolute /stable/ path not shortlink.
sam: will do. @jamie can you upload the new image to the CDN? I don't have write perms to the `docs-assets` bucket. ETA EOD.
jamie: can do after lunch. FYI ops mentioned the shortlink service is deprecated next week — I'll add a one-line note in the runbook to migrate to `/stable/` paths.
maria: nice — thanks everyone :thumbsup: @docs-bot can you add a deprecation reminder tag to the page for follow-up?
docs-bot: Reminder created: `deprecation-note` on /runbooks/oncall/redirects. Will notify owners in 7 days.
sam: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4821 — changes: replace shortlink with /stable/redirects, swap screenshot, add one-line migration note. PTAL. (thread will contain the tiny sed patch)
kevin: reviewing now, one tiny style nit about alt text. lgtm after that. @maria can you smoke test post-deploy?
maria: yep, i'll smoke test after deploy and confirm here. Thanks all!
